coordinate_and_dimension_split: p12-p17 placement coordinates and every heldout width/height were fixed before any native run; heldout widths/heights do not occur in fit

native_truth_origin.bounds: actual leaf UIView.bounds read in accessibilityValue getter
native_truth_origin.accessibility_frame: actual leaf UIView.accessibilityFrame public in-process getter; default UIKit implementation
native_truth_origin.screen_scale: actual attached window.screen.scale, UIScreen.main.scale only while unattached
native_truth_origin.identity: per-instance UUID plus ObjectIdentifier(self), not merely source declarations
native_truth_origin.xcui_frame: public XCUIElementSnapshot.frame from the existing observer, an independent transport channel

prespecified_precision.native_ax_or_projection_error: retain unrounded numeric residuals; do not choose tolerance after reading outcomes
prespecified_precision.fractional_inputs: binary-exact multiples of 1/8 or 1/4, plus integers

scope: Identity transforms, UIKit UIView leaves, finite fixed canvas, current captured simulator/environment. Numerical/projection calibration only. UIView.bounds is local layout geometry; accessibilityFrame is a screen-space accessibility boundary, and equality is not universal.
